module.title: Identity & Access — User Accounts and Security
module.business_purpose: Manages login accounts, credentials, MFA, devices and sessions. A user record is an authenticating account, not a person, patient or practitioner. Human identity and role profiles are modeled separately in Module 05 and linked optionally so patients and external professionals can exist without portal credentials.
